application.source: classification mapping required by the facts audit brief
application.note: Off-grid household solar and battery systems, classed with aitio's off-grid systems (maintainer, 2026-10-13).

chemistry.note: Neither the release nor its paper or record states the cell chemistry.

units_released.note: Rule: one battery per household. Released unit identifiers require package-specific inspection.

cells_liion.note: The release gives pack- or system-level signals and no cell topology.

cells_leadacid.note: No lead-acid cell count applies or is exposed in this release.

cell_channels_measured.note: No individual cell-voltage channels are released.

energy_mwh.note: Present usable energy computed from the data: coulomb counting over runs of at least 40 points of SOC with no gap over 300 s, ampere-hours per 100 percent SOC times mean pack voltage, median per unit, summed. STAR-A only: the other three households never swing 40 percent SOC.

energy_basis.source: energy_mwh is computed from the released data

span_unit_years.note: unit-years is first to last valid battery time per household (clock-reset times left out), summed; PV Battery_state 2 (Fault) is the charge controller's state, not a battery fault label, so faults stay 0

obs_hours.note: Calendar spans are measurable, so observation-hours are not used.

fault_onset_timestamp.source: docs/descriptor/TABLE3_faults.md; released labels and metadata contain no explicit fault-onset timestamp field

sentinels_documented.source: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.3959739; public data record and released documentation state no sentinel convention
sentinels_documented.note: Observed, not documented: battery times reset to 1969-12-31 20:00 and 1987, SOC outside 0 to 1000 and currents above 32,767 mA (unsigned 16-bit); clean=True masks the times and SOC values (fielddata/loaders/brazil_star_SCHEMA.md).
